title: ExplorerUsage
responsibility: Lists revision-scoped consumers through shared navigable screenshot-preview links.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.consumers
inputs.description: Referenced consumers at the shown revision, or empty for a dash.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.nav
inputs.description: Navigation preserving the selected branch and commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.lens
inputs.description: The selected revision evidence resolver; no screenshot is borrowed from another entity.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.mediaBase
inputs.description: URL prefix resolving the referenced screenshot file.

outputs.name: ExplorerUsage
outputs.description: Compact Used In links or a dash, using the same preview component in catalogs and relationship cards.
